description: Get a free, binding price quote for a metered Cap before calling it. This does not start provider work, reserve funds, spend a free call, or charge anything. Pass the complete `input` exactly as you will call it — the quote is bound to that input, the Cap, and your identity for 10 minutes. For capped_actual Caps also pass `limits` (per-line maximum quantities); add `max_charge_micro_usd` to hold spending under your own budget. Then pass the returned quote_id to call_cap with a stable idempotency_key. One quote can create one order; a new key cannot reprice an old order. Needs the user's qumge key.

input.description: The complete input you intend to call with; validated against the operation's input_schema.

limits.description: For capped_actual operations: line key → maximum quantity for this order. Required for every output-metered line, and never above the Cap's limit.

max_charge_micro_usd.description: Optional lower budget. The quote fails if the authorized amount would exceed it.

qumge_key.description: Optional: your Qumge API key, for clients that cannot set an Authorization header. Takes precedence over the header. Never echoed back.

name: quote_cap
